Savant Homes are more than just smart, they have a backup plan when the power goes out. Automate

[Learn More][3]

individually. Our powerful automation software along with the simple, intuitive Savant app help you
live your life normally even when the grid is down.

[Learn More][4]

All the music you love from your favorite music services, with a new personalized dashboard,
cross-service searching, and more.

[Learn More][5]

Don’t stop your life when the power goes out. With a Savant Power System you won’t even notice when
it’s gone.

Lighting, climate, music, video... it all needs to work together to give you the best experience.

## What is Armoury Crate?

Armoury Crate is an all-in-one system management software developed by ASUS for ROG and TUF gaming
devices. It allows users to control performance modes, customize RGB lighting with Aura Sync,
monitor CPU and GPU performance, and manage connected ASUS hardware from one central dashboard.

It is designed to simplify system control by combining performance tuning, device customization,
driver updates, and system monitoring into a single, easy-to-use interface, making it ideal for
gamers and power users.

## Why Use Armoury Crate?

### **All-in-One Control Hub for ASUS Gaming Systems**

Armoury Crate is ASUS’s official system management software, built to give gamers complete control
over their hardware from a single, unified interface. Whether you’re fine-tuning performance,
customizing RGB lighting, or monitoring system health in real time, Armoury Crate brings everything
together so you spend less time configuring and more time playing.

### **Centralized Control for All Your ASUS Devices**

Managing multiple peripherals used to mean juggling multiple apps. Armoury Crate eliminates that
frustration by unifying control of your ASUS motherboard, GPU, keyboard, mouse, headset, and other
compatible devices in one place. Any setting, any device one dashboard.

### **Performance Profiles Tailored to Your Game**

Armoury Crate lets you create and switch between custom performance profiles so your system
automatically adapts to whatever you’re running. Push your CPU and GPU harder during intense
sessions, or dial back power consumption when you’re browsing or watching content. The right balance
of power and efficiency, always on demand.

### **Advanced Aura Sync RGB Lighting**

Bring your setup to life with Aura Sync, built directly into Armoury Crate. Synchronize RGB lighting
across all compatible ASUS and partner devices, choose from a wide library of effects, or create
your own. Every peripheral, every light strip, every fan perfectly in sync.

### **Real-Time System Monitoring**

Stay informed with live hardware data at a glance. Armoury Crate displays CPU temperature, GPU load,
fan speeds, RAM usage, and more — giving you the visibility you need to keep your system running at
its best and catch potential issues before they become problems.

### **Game Library and Scenario Profiles**

Armoury Crate can detect your installed games and automatically apply the optimal system settings
the moment you launch them. No manual switching required. Each title gets the configuration it
deserves, hands-free.

### **Regular Updates and Expanding Compatibility**

ASUS continuously updates Armoury Crate with new features, driver integrations, and device support.
As your setup grows, your software grows with it always current, always compatible.

About the Software

## What is Asus Aura SYNC Utility?

If you’ve ever built a PC with ASUS parts, you probably know the pain of getting all your RGB to
actually cooperate. Half your components want to cycle through rainbow mode, the other half are
stuck on static red, and nothing talks to each other. That’s the exact problem the **Asus Aura Sync
Utility** was built to solve.

The Asus Aura Sync Utility is a software application developed by ASUS to provide centralized
control over RGB lighting in compatible devices and components. It’s designed primarily for gamers,
PC enthusiasts, and modders who want one app to rule all their lighting. Aura Sync lets you create
custom lighting effects, choose from millions of colors (16.8 million, technically), and synchronize
everything across your whole ASUS ecosystem. We’re talking motherboards like the ROG Strix Z790
series, graphics cards, monitors, keyboards, mice, and even third-party peripherals that support the
Aura Sync protocol.

Here’s the thing most people don’t realize: you can actually run Aura Sync as a **standalone
utility** without installing Armoury Crate. The latest standalone version is

# **DALI: globally standardized smart lighting control**

The DALI Alliance is the global industry organization for **DALI®**, the
**internationally-standardized protocol for digital communication between lighting-control
devices**. DALI is the Digital Addressable Lighting Interface.

Building on the long-established benefits of DALI, the **DALI-2****™**** certification program**
brings the promise of significantly improved interoperability along with more features and functions
including sensing and data gathering. Meanwhile, **D4i™** enables DALI for intelligent, IoT-ready
luminaires. We have also introduced different connectivity options over wireless and IP-based
networks and added the new **DALI+™** brand.

>> Find out more [about the DALI Alliance][60], also known as the **Digital Illumination Interface
Alliance (DiiA)**.

>> Sign up to our [mailing list][61] >> Join in the [DALI Official Group][62] on LinkedIn

# **DALI: globally standardized smart lighting control**

The DALI Alliance is the global industry organization for **DALI®**, the
**internationally-standardized protocol for digital communication between lighting-control
devices**. DALI is the Digital Addressable Lighting Interface.

Building on the long-established benefits of DALI, the **DALI-2****™**** certification program**
brings the promise of significantly improved interoperability along with more features and functions
including sensing and data gathering. Meanwhile, **D4i™** enables DALI for intelligent, IoT-ready
luminaires. We have also introduced different connectivity options over wireless and IP-based
networks and added the new **DALI+™** brand.

>> Find out more [about the DALI Alliance][60], also known as the **Digital Illumination Interface
Alliance (DiiA)**.

>> Sign up to our [mailing list][61] >> Join in the [DALI Official Group][62] on LinkedIn

Connect your tools, data, and workflows through an agentic orchestration layer so your work flows
seamlessly from briefing to strategy, content, media, measurement, and learning. Turn AI into a
better way of working without a walled garden.

We have a track record of 18+ years harnessing Adobe’s potential and are the proud holders of
Adobe’s Digital Strategic Innovation Partner of the Year 2025.

With our unique 50/50 split across tech and marketing, we combine leading commerce solutions, robust
yet easy-to-use content management, media optimisation, AI, and innovative data insights to enable
organisations to exceed customer expectations, build trust, and accelerate business growth.

## We Speak the Language of the Plans

When you pull an architectural drawing and it specifies a Lithonia WF6 LED or a Focal Point Seem 4
recessed — you need a supplier who already knows what that means and can price it today.

We don't just stock fixtures. We understand specifications, comply with energy codes, and can drop
ship directly to job sites nationwide.

#### Spec-Grade Products

We stock the brands that appear on architectural drawings — not commodity substitutes.

#### Title 24 & DLC Support

Every product we source is vetted for energy code compliance and utility rebate eligibility.

#### Nationwide Drop Ship

Ship directly to job sites anywhere in the US. No minimum order on most lines.

#### Competitive EC Pricing

Contractor-tier pricing on all lines. Volume discounts on project orders.

## Have specs? Send them over.

We'll quote any manufacturer, any SKU, any quantity. Typically within 24-48 hours.

You’ve probably seen plenty of “smart home” products out there. Sure, they look cool with all their
fancy features, but let’s be honest—they usually come with complicated setups and need a top-notch
home network. For most of us who aren’t tech wizards or electricians, that’s just way too much
hassle.

That’s where Smart+ comes in. It’s designed to make your life easier, not harder. It’s the only
system that combines effortless setup, wireless freedom, and seamless synchronization—all in one.

No drilling, no mess. Every light and sensor comes with strong adhesive backing, so even if you’re
not a DIY expert, you can handle it.

    area of stadium lighting, we have a lot of practical experience in customizing lighting

    the visual experience and functionality of these venues. Structural stability, use friendly for
    installation, good heat dissipation, lightweight, small size, and long span life all affect the
    cost-effectiveness of engineering costs on lights.

## What is an LED Display?

LED displays, also called LED screens or LED video walls, are large-format digital displays made of
modular panels containing thousands of light-emitting diodes (LEDs). These panels or cabinets work
together to create seamless visual surfaces capable of showing images, video and real-time
information with high brightness and excellent visibility. Unlike traditional LCD video walls,
Direct View LED technology generates light directly from each pixel.

This allows greater brightness, more flexible sizes and formats, and better performance in
challenging lighting conditions, both indoors and outdoors. Today LED displays are widely used in
digital signage and visual communication in retail stores, corporate meeting rooms, stadiums,
transport hubs, control rooms and public information systems. Thanks to their modular design, they
can be built in almost any size or shape, from compact indoor installations to giant outdoor digital
billboards.

[ Complete Guide ][103]

## Indoor vs outdoor LED displays

LED displays are designed differently depending on the environment where they are installed. Indoor
and outdoor systems share the same core technology but are engineered to meet very different
requirements in terms of brightness, protection, viewing distance and structural design. Indoor LED
displays are optimized for controlled environments such as retail stores, corporate meeting rooms,
showrooms and broadcast studios, where high resolution and short viewing distances are essential.

Outdoor LED displays, outdoor LED screens and large-format LED video walls, on the other hand, are
built to withstand weather conditions and deliver high brightness for perfect visibility in direct
sunlight, making them ideal for digital billboards, stadiums and public information systems.

### Indoor LED Display

Indoor LED displays are ideal for retail stores, showrooms, meeting rooms, control rooms, museums,
hospitality venues, and corporate environments where high definition, elegant design, and close-up
viewing are required.
* Fine-pitch
* High visual quality
* Seamless images
* Architectural integration
[ Discover more ][104]

### Outdoor LED Display

Outdoor LED displays are designed for digital billboards, smart cities, stadiums, transportation,
media facades, and events, ensuring high brightness and reliability in all weather conditions.
* High brightness
* 24/7 operation
* Water and dust protection
* Weather resistance

# [NAILD - National Association of Innovative Lighting Distributors]

## Your Business
## Lighting Edge

#### NAILD

is a national, nonprofit trade association driving lighting innovation through networking and
education.

Since 1977 our mission has been to provide our members with tools, resources and opportunities to
grow their businesses profitably.
[2026 Convention][32]

## Become a Member

Join leading lighting distributors, vendor manufacturers and lighting-focused associate members in
helping to move the industry forward. As a NAILD member you have access to and share abundant
lighting knowledge, networking and training resources while staying ahead of the curve on
cutting-edge lighting technology advances and design trends.

[Member Benefits][33] [Join Now][34]

## Legacy Training Programs

The **LS-I** and **LS-II** training programs provide companies in the lighting industry with a
measurable and systematic way to help educate staff, recognize their achievements and strengthen
their knowledge of lighting fundamentals. [**Learn more…**][35]

The **LS-I** program helps build staff confidence and competence in talking with customers about
lighting products and guiding their buying decisions. [**Learn more…**][36]

**LS-II** takes your lighting expertise and sales skills to the next level to transform course
participants from “product providers” to trusted lighting solutions professionals. [**Learn
more…**][37]

## Continuing Education

**LS-Evolve** is NAILD’s exclusive online training program featuring a semi-freeform modular
structure where learners are empowered to pick and choose which module(s) they wish to study,
on-demand.

Learn at your own pace and keep coming back for continued access to all the latest modules as we
regularly add more great lighting knowledge to help grow your business to the next level!

[Contact NAILD for access][38]

## NAILD Lighting Controls Certification

Kickstart your lighting controls knowledge and skills with NAILD’s [**Lighting Specialist in
Controls (LS-C) training**][39]! Registration is now open! Choose one of three tracks for
specialization in either the design, distribution or installation of lighting controls. Certificate
holders will be able to design, distribute, or install select products by the endorsing vendors.
Questions? Check out the **[LS-C FAQ][40]**page or check out the **[LS-C Instructor Bios][41]**.

# [NAILD - National Association of Innovative Lighting Distributors]

## Your Business
## Lighting Edge

#### NAILD

is a national, nonprofit trade association driving lighting innovation through networking and
education.

Since 1977 our mission has been to provide our members with tools, resources and opportunities to
grow their businesses profitably.
[2026 Convention][32]

## Become a Member

Join leading lighting distributors, vendor manufacturers and lighting-focused associate members in
helping to move the industry forward. As a NAILD member you have access to and share abundant
lighting knowledge, networking and training resources while staying ahead of the curve on
cutting-edge lighting technology advances and design trends.

[Member Benefits][33] [Join Now][34]

## Legacy Training Programs

The **LS-I** and **LS-II** training programs provide companies in the lighting industry with a
measurable and systematic way to help educate staff, recognize their achievements and strengthen
their knowledge of lighting fundamentals. [**Learn more…**][35]

The **LS-I** program helps build staff confidence and competence in talking with customers about
lighting products and guiding their buying decisions. [**Learn more…**][36]

**LS-II** takes your lighting expertise and sales skills to the next level to transform course
participants from “product providers” to trusted lighting solutions professionals. [**Learn
more…**][37]

## Continuing Education

**LS-Evolve** is NAILD’s exclusive online training program featuring a semi-freeform modular
structure where learners are empowered to pick and choose which module(s) they wish to study,
on-demand.

Learn at your own pace and keep coming back for continued access to all the latest modules as we
regularly add more great lighting knowledge to help grow your business to the next level!

[Contact NAILD for access][38]

## NAILD Lighting Controls Certification

Kickstart your lighting controls knowledge and skills with NAILD’s [**Lighting Specialist in
Controls (LS-C) training**][39]! Registration is now open! Choose one of three tracks for
specialization in either the design, distribution or installation of lighting controls. Certificate
holders will be able to design, distribute, or install select products by the endorsing vendors.
Questions? Check out the **[LS-C FAQ][40]**page or check out the **[LS-C Instructor Bios][41]**.

# GITEX Global 2023

**Newcom** is excited to announce our participation in **GITEX Global 2023**, to be held in Dubai
from 16th-20th October, with a groundbreaking campaign, “Unleash Productivity Beyond Imagination.”

Our booth at **GITEX** will serve as a productivity solutions hub dedicated to enhancing
productivity across diverse work environments. We have meticulously divided our solutions into two
core segments:
* **Enterprise solutions: **This section highlights classroom and conference room connectivity,
  offering advanced video, audio, and conferencing solutions for immersive learning and
  transformative corporate meetings.
* **Personal workspace solutions:** Newcom offers personal workspace products for diverse
  workstyles. This segment aims to highlight a combination of tools suitable for traditional offices
  to hybrid setups, work-from-home, or on-the-go, aimed at enhancing productivity in ways that meet
  modern work culture.

You can learn more by visiting our GITEX page. Dive deep into the philosophy behind our campaign,
explore detailed solution descriptions, book meetings with experts, and get to know the company’s
dedicated GITEX team.

We invite you to join us at GITEX to revolutionize your work and experience productivity in ways
unimaginable.

Our booth at **GITEX** will serve as a productivity solutions hub dedicated to enhancing
productivity across diverse work environments. We have meticulously divided our solutions into two
core segments:

  transformative corporate meetings.
* **Personal workspace solutions:** Newcom offers personal workspace products for diverse
  workstyles. This segment aims to highlight a combination of tools suitable for traditional offices
  to hybrid setups, work-from-home, or on-the-go, aimed at enhancing productivity in ways that meet
  modern work culture.

# NexLight Lighting Control Systems

For the Life of Your Building.

[

Our Products

][18]
[Industrial ceiling with metal beams and pipes.]

## One System For Your
## Entire Lighting Network

At NexLight, we pride ourselves on delivering some of the most stable and reliable lighting control
systems in the industry. Specializing in high-reliability, low-voltage systems and sensors for the
commercial building market, our solutions are built to last. Many of our systems have been in
operation since the 1990s, a testament to our quality and durability.

We support our products long-term through lifetime phone support, reverse compatibility, and ongoing
technological innovation, ensuring your investment continues to perform seamlessly. Discover how
NexLight’s proven solutions can elevate your building’s lighting control today.

[

Our History

][19]

## Our Products

Our products are industrial-grade, known for their durability and minimal need for callbacks or
warranty claims. We offer a range of solutions, including standard panels, custom panels, and field
devices.

### Lighting Control Panels

Our panel products include standard configurations R Series, dimming D Series, or custom panels
tailored to your building’s needs.

[

View Products

][20]

### 2-Wire Devices

Our 2-wire devices include low voltage switches, sensors, and input devices for flexible and
customizable solutions for your lighting fixtures.

[

View Products

][21]

### Stand Alone Controls

Our stand alone sensors automatically adjust ambient light levels, improving energy efficiency and
reducing occupancy costs.

[

View Products

][22]

### Retrofit Solutions

Our modular panel devices make retrofitting easier than ever, ensuring seamless, reliable and
cost-effective solutions to your retrofit process.

[

View Products

][23]

### Legacy Components

We provide long-term support on these discontinued NexLight products, so that your system remains
functional and up-to-date.

[

View Products

][24]

### Custom Panels

Our UL508A Panel Shop designs and builds custom panels tailored to your unique project needs with
expert craftsmanship and high standards.

[

View Products

][25]

## Find A Representative Near You

We have representatives across the United States, Canada, and South America, ready to assist you
with your lighting control needs. Explore your local area to find a representative near you or
explore locations that are still seeking representation.

[

Rep Finder

][26]
[Modern factory with machinery and metal materials.]

## Service Guarantee

Our service guarantee means that when you call us, you'll talk to a real person—not a call
menu—during business hours. We pride ourselves on our quick response times for quotes and tech
support, often responding within hours or days, thanks to our lean manufacturing and inventory
processes.

[

Contact Us

][27]

## American-Crafted Excellence

[Warehouse aisle with stacked cardboard boxes]

NexLight system solutions are designed, assembled, wired, programmed, and inventoried in the U.S.,
ready for shipment worldwide. All panel construction is conducted under UL approval in Baxter,
Minnesota. Additionally, our advanced component engineering, development, and testing facilities are
located in Baxter, Minnesota, and Seoul, South Korea, ensuring quality and innovation at every
stage.

[

Contact Us

][28]

# NexLight Lighting Control Systems

For the Life of Your Building.

[

Our Products

][18]
[Industrial ceiling with metal beams and pipes.]

## One System For Your
## Entire Lighting Network

At NexLight, we pride ourselves on delivering some of the most stable and reliable lighting control
systems in the industry. Specializing in high-reliability, low-voltage systems and sensors for the
commercial building market, our solutions are built to last. Many of our systems have been in
operation since the 1990s, a testament to our quality and durability.

We support our products long-term through lifetime phone support, reverse compatibility, and ongoing
technological innovation, ensuring your investment continues to perform seamlessly. Discover how
NexLight’s proven solutions can elevate your building’s lighting control today.

[

Our History

][19]

## Our Products

Our products are industrial-grade, known for their durability and minimal need for callbacks or
warranty claims. We offer a range of solutions, including standard panels, custom panels, and field
devices.

### Lighting Control Panels

Our panel products include standard configurations R Series, dimming D Series, or custom panels
tailored to your building’s needs.

[

View Products

][20]

### 2-Wire Devices

Our 2-wire devices include low voltage switches, sensors, and input devices for flexible and
customizable solutions for your lighting fixtures.

[

View Products

][21]

### Stand Alone Controls

Our stand alone sensors automatically adjust ambient light levels, improving energy efficiency and
reducing occupancy costs.

[

View Products

][22]

### Retrofit Solutions

Our modular panel devices make retrofitting easier than ever, ensuring seamless, reliable and
cost-effective solutions to your retrofit process.

[

View Products

][23]

### Legacy Components

We provide long-term support on these discontinued NexLight products, so that your system remains
functional and up-to-date.

[

View Products

][24]

### Custom Panels

Our UL508A Panel Shop designs and builds custom panels tailored to your unique project needs with
expert craftsmanship and high standards.

[

View Products

][25]

## Find A Representative Near You

We have representatives across the United States, Canada, and South America, ready to assist you
with your lighting control needs. Explore your local area to find a representative near you or
explore locations that are still seeking representation.

[

Rep Finder

][26]
[Modern factory with machinery and metal materials.]

## Service Guarantee

Our service guarantee means that when you call us, you'll talk to a real person—not a call
menu—during business hours. We pride ourselves on our quick response times for quotes and tech
support, often responding within hours or days, thanks to our lean manufacturing and inventory
processes.

[

Contact Us

][27]

## American-Crafted Excellence

[Warehouse aisle with stacked cardboard boxes]

NexLight system solutions are designed, assembled, wired, programmed, and inventoried in the U.S.,
ready for shipment worldwide. All panel construction is conducted under UL approval in Baxter,
Minnesota. Additionally, our advanced component engineering, development, and testing facilities are
located in Baxter, Minnesota, and Seoul, South Korea, ensuring quality and innovation at every
stage.

[

Contact Us

][28]

## Open source RGB lighting control that doesn't depend on manufacturer software


One of the biggest complaints about RGB is the software ecosystem surrounding it. Every manufacturer
has their own app, their own brand, their own style. If you want to mix and match devices, you end
up with a ton of conflicting, functionally identical apps competing for your background resources.
On top of that, these apps are proprietary and Windows-only. Some even require online accounts. What
if there was a way to control all of your RGB devices from a single app, on both Windows and Linux,
without any nonsense? That is what OpenRGB sets out to achieve. One app to rule them all.

[[Download Windows]][16] [[Download Linux]][17] [[Download MacOS]][18]

Version 1.0rc3, [additional downloads and versions on Releases page][19]

[OpenRGB user interface]

Control RGB without wasting system resources

## Lightweight User Interface

OpenRGB keeps it simple with a lightweight user interface that doesn't waste background resources
with excessive custom images and styles. It is light on both RAM and CPU usage, so your system can
continue to shine without cutting into your gaming or productivity performance.

[OpenRGB rules them all]

Control RGB from a single app

## Eliminate Bloatware

If you have RGB devices from many different manufacturers, you will likely have many different
programs installed to control all of your devices. These programs do not sync with each other, and
they all compete for your system resources. OpenRGB aims to replace every single piece of
proprietary RGB software with one lightweight app.

[[OpenRGB is open source software]][20]

Contribute your RGB devices

## Open Source

OpenRGB is free and open source software under the GNU General Public License version 2. This means
anyone is free to view and modify the code. If you know C++, you can add your own device with our
flexible RGB hardware abstraction layer. Being open source means more devices are constantly being
added!

[Check out the source code on GitLab][21]
[OpenRGB is Cross-Platform]

Control RGB on Windows, Linux, and MacOS

## Cross-Platform

OpenRGB runs on Windows, Linux and MacOS. No longer is RGB control a Windows-exclusive feature!
OpenRGB has been tested on X86, X86_64, ARM32, and ARM64 processors including ARM mini-PCs such as
the Raspberry Pi.

[[OpenRGB provides a network-based Software Development Kit]][22]

Integrate RGB into your games, music, and more

## OpenRGB SDK

OpenRGB provides a network-based Software Development Kit, which allows third-party software to
control all of your RGB. This allows for game integrations, music visualization, ambient lighting,
and anything else you can imagine. SDK bindings are available for multiple programming languages
including C++, Python, C#, Java, and more. OpenRGB also includes an SDK client so you can
synchronize multiple systems over the network.

[Explore OpenRGB SDK][23]
[[OpenRGB Plugins]][24]

Extend OpenRGB with Plugins

## Plugin Interface

OpenRGB provides a plugin interface. Plugins can add additional functionality to the OpenRGB user
interface. These can provide new features without having to run external software. Existing plugins
include an effects engine, an E1.31 data receiver, and a visual layout editor.

[Explore OpenRGB Plugins][25]

with excessive custom images and styles. It is light on both RAM and CPU usage, so your system can

## Eliminate Bloatware

If you have RGB devices from many different manufacturers, you will likely have many different
programs installed to control all of your devices. These programs do not sync with each other, and

anyone is free to view and modify the code. If you know C++, you can add your own device with our

the Raspberry Pi.

control all of your RGB. This allows for game integrations, music visualization, ambient lighting,
and anything else you can imagine. SDK bindings are available for multiple programming languages
including C++, Python, C#, Java, and more. OpenRGB also includes an SDK client so you can
synchronize multiple systems over the network.

# PLC training you can actually run

Hands-on online PLC training for beginners, technicians, and controls candidates. Follow a
structured path, write ladder logic, run machine scenarios, and diagnose faults in PLC Simulation
Software—without installing vendor software.

[Start PLC training free→][8][See the training path][9]
* 6 free lessons per dialect
* 8 PLC learning dialects
* No install or credit card
[Industrial PLC training bench with a laptop showing ladder logic beside a process tank, conveyor,
I/O rack and emergency-stop controls]
Editorial illustration · product capture below
A training bench connects programme logic to the sensors, actuators, I/O, and safety devices the
logic controls.

Direct answer

## What is PLC training?

PLC training teaches you to read inputs, write control logic, test outputs, and troubleshoot machine
behaviour on programmable logic controllers. Effective training combines theory with repeated
practice. This path adds a browser simulator so you can run ladder logic before you work on physical
equipment.

The simulator is a learning and prototyping environment. It does not replace vendor-specific
commissioning practice, risk assessment, electrical safety training, or final testing on the target
controller and machine.

[Explore the hands-on PLC training platform→][10]
[Real PLC Simulation Software training screen showing a traffic-light scenario, Run tests controls,
playback speed, and live intersection state]
Real product capture · demo scenario
The learner runs a defined machine scenario, observes the state, and tests the programme against
expected behaviour.

See the learning loop

## Don’t only watch someone else programme

Passive courses explain the instruction. Hands-on PLC programming training makes you predict the
state, write the logic, run it, and explain why it passed or failed.
1. 01Choose a guided lesson, machine scenario, or open sandbox.
2. 02Write and inspect ladder logic or Structured Text.
3. 03Run the programme and watch the machine state respond.
4. 04Use the result and I/O evidence to correct the logic.

[Create a free account][11][Run the first rung][12]

Hands-on PLC programming training

## Build it. Run it. Break it. Prove it.

The strongest training loop connects code to visible industrial behaviour, then makes you reason
through the failure path.

[PLC training bench with a conveyor, photoelectric sensor, stack light, I/O rack and laptop
displaying ladder logic]
01Editorial illustration

### Build the control sequence

Turn a requirement into contacts, coils, interlocks, timers, and a sequence you can explain rung by
rung.

[Stainless process tank training rig with level sensors, pump, PLC I/O and a red amber green stack
light]
02Editorial illustration

### Run the process

Watch tank level, pump state, sensors, and outputs change so the scan cycle becomes behaviour—not a
diagram to memorise.

[Technician using a multimeter to diagnose a PLC training panel with contactors, safety relay, I/O
modules and terminal blocks]
03Editorial illustration

### Diagnose the fault

Trace the evidence from power and field wiring through the input state, programme condition, and
commanded output.

Structured online PLC training

## What this PLC training path covers

Start with controller behaviour, then move through logic, sequences, diagnostics, and cross-dialect
comparison. The editorial guides explain the engineering; the training product supplies the
repeatable practice.

[Three unbranded PLC training racks wired to the same motor and stack light beside a laptop showing
ladder logic]
Editorial illustration: learn the control requirement once, then compare how supported PLC dialects
express it.
1. 01
   
   ### PLC fundamentals
   
   Inputs, outputs, the scan cycle, addressing, Boolean logic, safe states, and how a controller
   turns field conditions into repeatable machine behaviour.
   
   Read: [PLC programming fundamentals][13] · [scan-cycle guide][14]
2. 02
   
   ### Ladder logic that works

# Why Choose QLC+?



## Say goodbye to expensive consoles

###### Open Source

QLC+ is continuously evolving and improving with the support of a global community of users and
developers.

###### User Friendly

QLC+ is designed to be easy to use, with an intuitive interface that makes it accessible to users at
all levels of expertise.

###### Hardware Compatibility

QLC+ supports a wide range of lighting interfaces and fixtures, making it adaptable to a variety of
equipment setups.

###### Virtual Console

Users can create their own virtual console for a highly personalized and efficient workflow.

###### Abundant Plugins

Plugins make it possible for QLC+ to integrate with a wide variety of technologies including OSC,
Art-Net, s.ACN, MIDI and more!

###### Audio Triggers

Use an audio input to trigger different lighting looks or step through a cue-list. BPM detection
coming soon!

###### Scriptable

Scripting in QLC+ allows you to extend your light show. You can trigger scenes, blackouts and even
system commands!

###### OS Independent

Run your lighting console on Windows, MacOS or Linux.

# Why Choose QLC+?



## Say goodbye to expensive consoles

###### Open Source

QLC+ is continuously evolving and improving with the support of a global community of users and
developers.

###### User Friendly

QLC+ is designed to be easy to use, with an intuitive interface that makes it accessible to users at
all levels of expertise.

###### Hardware Compatibility

QLC+ supports a wide range of lighting interfaces and fixtures, making it adaptable to a variety of
equipment setups.

###### Virtual Console

Users can create their own virtual console for a highly personalized and efficient workflow.

###### Abundant Plugins

Plugins make it possible for QLC+ to integrate with a wide variety of technologies including OSC,
Art-Net, s.ACN, MIDI and more!

###### Audio Triggers

Use an audio input to trigger different lighting looks or step through a cue-list. BPM detection
coming soon!

###### Scriptable

Scripting in QLC+ allows you to extend your light show. You can trigger scenes, blackouts and even
system commands!

###### OS Independent

Run your lighting console on Windows, MacOS or Linux.

## Unique and patented technology

**SEAK SMART** is a reliable lighting control system for commercial and industrial buildings that
uses existing power lines for communication. Besides lighting, **SEAK controls** also provide
connectivity for electric vehicle chargers and other IoT devices.

#### Outdoor

Manage the light intensity for the whole city, for luminaire groups or for each luminaire
individually via web browser.

#### Indoor

Add luminosity and motion sensors. SEAK system will automatically balance light intensity to get you
the right light at minimum consumption.

#### Charging

Power capacity is automatically evenly distributed among charging cars according to their charging
needs, capacity available and user profiles. Green energy can be prioritized for charging.

## Unique and patented technology

**SEAK SMART** is a reliable lighting control system for commercial and industrial buildings that
uses existing power lines for communication. Besides lighting, **SEAK controls** also provide
connectivity for electric vehicle chargers and other IoT devices.

#### Outdoor

Manage the light intensity for the whole city, for luminaire groups or for each luminaire
individually via web browser.

#### Indoor

Add luminosity and motion sensors. SEAK system will automatically balance light intensity to get you
the right light at minimum consumption.

#### Charging

Power capacity is automatically evenly distributed among charging cars according to their charging
needs, capacity available and user profiles. Green energy can be prioritized for charging.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Do you ship worldwide?

Yes, we ship to over 200 countries via Sea (FCL/LCL), Air Cargo, Express (DHL/UPS), or Rail.

Can I get samples before bulk order?

Yes. You can add a single item to your procurement list as a sample request. We will consolidate
samples from multiple factories to save shipping costs.

Can you source custom products (OEM)?

Absolutely. Send us your design drawings or technical requirements, and we will find a qualified
factory to manufacture it for you.

## Club lighting

With its library of 3000+ DMX lighting fixtures and the pages concept, Sunlite Suite 3 is the
perfect lighting controller for nightclubs and bars.
The association with a MIDI controller make the software even more powerful and easy to manipulate.

[https://eu-media.n-g.co/cms_prod/concert_5d40419c7ffde.jpg]

## Concert lighting

A fast access to the lights is fundamental for live show control. This is why all software features
can be assigned to a MIDI controller to faster the control.
Plus, programming your light scenes with the palettes allows you to switch from stage to stage
without having to reprogram your show.

[https://eu-media.n-g.co/cms_prod/theater_5d41aed149375.jpg]

## THEATHER LIGHTING

Scenes, cue lists, manual or timed crossfade...Everything is included in Sunlite Suite 3 to make
theater lighting control efficient and easy to understand.
The association of a MIDI controller offers more control possibilities for live operation.

[https://eu-media.n-g.co/cms_prod/flagnac_5d42df6bf1c9e.jpg]

## sound & light show

Lights, sound, video, fountains...can all be synchronized using Sunlite Suite 3 timelines.
Drag&drop your effects to the timelines and have them sync through MTC or SMPTE timecode.

**manufacturer-neutral**, so our focus is entirely on reliable, high quality, high efficiency, and

## About Stouch Lighting

Stouch Lighting is a national LED distribution and implementation company. We are
**manufacturer-neutral**, so our focus is entirely on reliable, high quality, high efficiency, and
cost-effective products. We design solution-oriented packages around each client's particular goals
using a combination of industry experience, manufacturing partnerships, and logistical capabilities.
Different considerations to maximize your return on investment include warranty, up front costs, and
volume discounts.** [Contact us][70] **today to learn how **Stouch Lighting** can help your
organization reach its goals!

Tesco Controls, a UFT Company, is a leading full-service systems integrator and original equipment
manufacturer (OEM). Our business is designing, manufacturing and integrating electrical and process
control systems for water, wastewater, transportation, lighting, and renewable energy applications.
TESCO delivers high-value, innovative solutions designed to optimize operations, improve
communication and reduce operating costs. Since 1972, TESCO has successfully completed over 50,000

#### WE ARE LIGHTING DESIGN LEADERS.

The Lighting Practice transforms ordinary spaces into places that are extraordinary, captivating and
memorable. We accomplish this through careful listening, collaboration and dedication to achieving
our clients’ vision.

### Team Members

## An environment of openness.

From the space where we work to the people we call teammates, partners or clients, we operate and
thrive in a culture of communication and collaboration to make the most informed decisions for the
best possible results.

## A culture of learning.

The Lighting Practice is continually reviewing research on light and human health.  Our Light +
Health Group is committed to growing our knowledge on the impact of light and ways electric lighting
can benefit people within a space.

## A history of excellence.

The Lighting Practice has been creating distinctive lighting solutions since 1989. Our history of
on-going long-term relationships is due to our team’s ability to understand our clients’ goals and
deliver results beyond their expectations.

## A commitment to sharing knowledge.

The Lighting Practice is an AIA Continuing Education Provider in Pennsylvania, New Jersey, and New
York.  As a learning organization and leader in lighting design, The Lighting Practice prioritizes
educating our employees, design partners, and clients.

memorable. We accomplish this through careful listening, collaboration and dedication to achieving

thrive in a culture of communication and collaboration to make the most informed decisions for the
best possible results.

The Lighting Practice is continually reviewing research on light and human health.  Our Light +
Health Group is committed to growing our knowledge on the impact of light and ways electric lighting
can benefit people within a space.

on-going long-term relationships is due to our team’s ability to understand our clients’ goals and
deliver results beyond their expectations.

## A commitment to sharing knowledge.

The Lighting Practice is an AIA Continuing Education Provider in Pennsylvania, New Jersey, and New
York.  As a learning organization and leader in lighting design, The Lighting Practice prioritizes
educating our employees, design partners, and clients.

##### Three IC Families. One Standard of Control.

An LED driver IC is the small piece of silicon that decides whether a light source merely turns on
or performs: it regulates current so brightness stays constant as temperature and supply voltage
move, shapes dimming so the result is comfortable to eyes and invisible to cameras, and protects the
LEDs it serves from the electrical environment around them. Get the driver wrong and even premium
LEDs flicker, shift colour and die early. Every part we ship belongs to a family with one clear job:
regulate current, survive its environment, and behave exactly as the datasheet promises — batch
after batch.

[YS-L SERIES Low-Voltage LED Driver Chips]
YS-L SERIES · LOW-VOLTAGE

Battery-friendly driver and flasher ICs for decorative, gift and toy lighting. A library of
pre-engineered flash, fade, breathe and strobe patterns is burned in through OTP programming — so
your product behaves the way your brand intends, straight off the line, with standby currents low
enough to protect shelf life.
Operating voltage: 1.8 - 5.5 V
Outputs: 1 - 8 channels
Drive current: 5 - 30 mA, OTP-set
Sleep current: < 1 µA

YS-A SERIES · AUTOMOTIVE

Purpose-built drivers for brake lights, turn signals, tail lamps and daytime running lights. Wide
input tolerance absorbs the abuse of real vehicle electrics, while open- and short-LED fault
detection and thermal foldback keep sealed lamps alive through summer heat soak. Sequential
turn-signal sweeps are supported natively.
Input tolerance: 5.5 - 40 V
Fault detection: Open / short LED
Thermal protection: Foldback + shutdown
Dimming: PWM ≥ 200 Hz, flicker-safe

Single-wire addressable controllers for ambient modules, pixel strips and smart-home lighting. Each
IC handles 256 brightness steps per channel at refresh rates high enough to stay invisible on
camera, with optional breakpoint-resume so one failed pixel never darkens the rest of the run — a
requirement we hear from every strip maker in 2026.
Interface: Single-wire, 800 kbps
Colour depth: 256 steps / channel
Refresh rate: ≥ 2 kHz, camera-safe
Fail-over: Breakpoint resume opt.

##### From First Waveform to Final Carton

Most failures in lighting electronics are born in the hand-offs between design house, fab broker and
assembly shop. We removed the hand-offs.
* *
Development
Application engineers translate your product brief flash cadence, brightness curve, power budget
into validated silicon behaviour before a single board is built.
1.Waveform & pattern design tuned to your brand's look
2.OTP firmware configuration; no mask charges for behaviour changes
3.Bench validation with documented test conditions
4.Engineering samples typically within 7 working days
5.English datasheets and application notes for every part
* *
Production
Wafers are sourced from established foundry partners, then probed, packaged and final-tested under
our own acceptance criteria — not the broker's.
1.Incoming wafer probe (CP) against family test programs
2.SOP-8, DFN and COB packaging options
3.100% final test (FT) on electrical parameters
4.Lot-coded reels with full upstream traceability
5.Dual-sourced wafer supply to buffer market swings
